```yaml
name: Claude Workflow

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/claude.yml"
      - "frontend/internal-packages/agent/**"

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  claude-workflow:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: ./.github/actions/pnpm-setup
        
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install
        
      - name: Build agent package
        run: pnpm --filter @liam-hq/agent build
        
      - name: Run tests
        run: pnpm --filter @liam-hq/agent test
        
      - name: Lint code
        run: pnpm --filter @liam-hq/agent lint
        
      - name: Type check
        run: pnpm --filter @liam-hq/agent type-check
        
      - name: Validate DDL execution implementation
        run: |
          # Verify that @liam-hq/pglite-server is installed
          if ! pnpm list @liam-hq/pglite-server --filter @liam-hq/agent; then
            echo "Error: @liam-hq/pglite-server is not installed in the agent package"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Verify executeDDLNode.ts exists and contains expected implementation
          if [ ! -f "frontend/internal-packages/agent/src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts" ]; then
            echo "Error: executeDDLNode.ts not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that the file contains executeQuery import and usage
          if ! grep -q "executeQuery" "frontend/internal-packages/agent/src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts"; then
            echo "Error: executeDDLNode.ts does not contain executeQuery usage"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Check that the file uses state.designSessionId
          if ! grep -q "designSessionId" "frontend/internal-packages/agent/src/nodes/executeDDLNode.ts"; then
            echo "Error: executeDDLNode.ts does not use designSessionId"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All validation checks passed"
```
